verdict.rationale: Jules explicitly supports assigning tasks directly from GitHub issues via the 'jules' label, and its API also enables custom workflows integrating with issue trackers like Linear and Slack. This directly matches the intent-to-spec story of turning an existing issue/ticket into an agent task. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation specifically of the label-to-task flow (community evidence covers general Jules usage but not this specific issue-assignment feature) and no detail on ticket systems beyond GitHub/Linear/Slack mentions.
